purpose: Small offline contract audit; synthetic interpretations are not human labels or a measurement of recommendation fit.

cases.question: Does a corrected today's goal replace the old genre without promoting past taste?
cases.passCriterion: The validated corrected projection contains current direction feature wants and no old genre/history preferences; raw correction remains available to the picker. A feature-backed direction need not create a separate genre string.

cases.question: Can a neutral answer become a negative preference?
cases.passCriterion: Unknown, indifferent and none without additional text cannot support an avoid/exclude fact.

cases.question: Does a conditional wish become a hard restriction?
cases.passCriterion: A validated conditional fact remains in the conversation but creates no unconditional goalRequires/goalExcludes.

cases.question: Can superseded company conditions reappear after editing the company?
cases.passCriterion: Changing group to solo removes facts sourced from the old context; the old source cannot validate a new proposal.

cases.question: Can an explicit current replay request reach candidates despite completed exposure?
cases.passCriterion: A completed game explicitly targeted for today's replay is admissible; a merely similar-game reference must not gain this permission.

cases.question: Does merely starting a game imply dislike or an exclusion?
cases.passCriterion: Started exposure alone leaves the game eligible and adds no negative taste weights.

cases.question: Does a deliberate return override a remembered block only for today without blocking the series?
cases.passCriterion: Result keep permits the current work/editions; restart clears keep and preserves the explicit block; unrelated series entries remain eligible.

cases.question: Can batch replacement, repeated transport and undo preserve the request and unaffected card?
cases.passCriterion: One successful duplicate replacement invokes picker once, planner zero times; undo restores exact prior cards with no additional picker.

cases.question: Can a restored old planner error answer the fallback question it displays?
cases.passCriterion: Actionless restore is free and its visible fallback question accepts the next answer without stale-question error.

cases.question: Does an explicit today's time budget reach feasibility checks separately from completion length?
cases.passCriterion: A validated 30-minute current budget results in session.minutes=30 and an explicit unknown interruption warning; total completion hours alone do not create a session budget.

cases.question: Do distinct supported today's signals affect retrieval without violating platform and hard filters?
cases.passCriterion: RPG/story, racing/driving and cooperative survival produce distinct scored shortlists; all shortlisted candidates pass current sieves. No particular title is required.

cases.question: Are uncertain player counts kept distinguishable from confirmed capacity?
cases.passCriterion: For a three-player group, every shortlisted card without verified capacity carries an unknown/conditional capacity check; verified impossible capacity never passes.
